notes: Adds an installer-gated 'Pulse Out 2' option on the Zones page: Alarm output 2 flashes about once a second instead of holding steady, as a visual alarm for a hearing-impaired occupant. Panel-wide, default off, so nothing changes unless it is enabled. Out 1 is always steady. Remote speakers flash in step and keep sounding their siren continuously, once their own firmware and the panel's comms module are updated too. Also fixes a disarm after an alarm replying late: the panel now answers the request before speaking its 'disarmed' and 'alarm in memory' clips, so a keypad no longer times out and shows a connection error for a disarm that worked.
